# War & Conflict Brief · 1 Oct 2026

## Ethiopia and Eritrea · Horn of Africa
- **Drone strike and explosion · Addis Abeba.** Explosions caused by suspected drone strikes are reported in Ethiopia's capital of Addis Abeba, including one near the Ethiopian National Defense Force' headquarters. (BBC News)
- **Diplomatic move.** Ethiopia closes its embassy in Eritrea and announces the expulsion of ten Eritrean diplomats from the country, after accusing its neighbour of financing the Tigray People's Liberation Front. (AP)
- **Diplomatic move.** Eritrea's foreign ministry announces that the country will cut off diplomatic ties with Ethiopia in response. (AFP via Al Arabiya, Reuters)
- **Diplomatic move.** A diplomat from Egypt is told to leave Ethiopia within 48 hours after being declared as persona non grata. (Reuters)

## Afghanistan–Pakistan war · South Asia
- **Airstrike · Kunar Province · 22 / 9 killed (the claims differ).** Pakistan launches airstrikes in Afghanistan, claiming the killing of 22 Taliban fighters at two locations, while the Government of Afghanistan reports that nine women and children are killed in Kunar Province and Helmand Province by Pakistan airstrikes. (Al Jazeera)

## Eastern DR Congo · Africa
- **Humanitarian.** Ebola response faces setback as transit centre burns down in DR Congo camp

## Israel–Palestine: Gaza and the West Bank · Middle East
- **Shooting · Yasuf, West Bank · 1 killed, 1 injured.** Israeli settlers shoot and kill a Palestinian man at his home in Yasuf, West Bank, and injure another. (Reuters)

## Russia–Ukraine war · Europe
- **Shootdown · Voronezh Oblast · 3 killed.** A Russian Su-35 fighter jet shoots down a Russian Mi-8 helicopter over Voronezh Oblast, Russia, in a friendly fire incident. All three crew members are killed. (Kyiv Independent)

## Sudanese civil war · Africa
- **Drone strike · El Obeid, North Kordofan · 5 killed.** A drone strike by the Rapid Support Forces on a dormitory at the University of Kordofan in El Obeid, North Kordofan, Sudan, kills five people. (Sudan Tribune)

## 2026 RAF Fairford arrests
- **Terrorism and arrests · Westminster, London, England.** British counter-terrorism police arrest a 25-year-old British-Iranian dual national in Westminster, London, England, on suspicion of preparing terrorist acts linked to the RAF Fairford investigation. Officers also search two properties in the area. (CNN)

## Airspace warnings
- EASA revises a Conflict Zone Information Bulletin for the airspace of Syria (CZIB-2017-03R20), valid until 2026-11-30
